brief: LeaseLeak — drop your rent roll spreadsheet and see in five seconds how much rent you're leaving on the table, which leases expire in the wrong month, and get the renewal letters written. Built for small landlords and mom-and-pop multifamily owners with 4 to 50 units who track leases in a spreadsheet. Uses public HUD Fair Market Rent and Zillow ZORI data. Fintech-grade seriousness, real dollar figures, no hype.
